detail.label: Final burn pitch
detail.explanation:
Final burn pitch

The upward angle of thrust at the end of the planned burn.

What to check

This user-defined profile applies to manual guidance. Assisted target guidance ignores the manual pitch schedule and commands its own ideal attitude. A valid angle alone does not ensure orbit insertion or landing.

𝛾
 · Flight pitch: full explanation

The manual engine tilts gradually from initial to final pitch during the requested burn. A higher angle gives more upward support and less sideways push. Assisted guidance ignores this setting.
